clause_1_bar.MEETS THE BAR: official unprojected pooled SLU-F1 >= 64.00 AND official intent (scenario+action) >= 78.00
clause_1_bar.beside: the v3-projected and TRAIN symmetric numbers as diagnostics; state whether the v3 number would have cleared 64.00

clause_1_bar.on_missing: the bar is NOT lowered (owner decision 20); decision 15's order resumes and B5b reads against the same bar

clause_2_combination.ADMITTED: CI95 lower bound of (B5e - B1) pooled official SLU > 0 AND (B5e - B1) intent CI95 lower bound > -1.0051 AND no scenario's paired intent CI95 upper bound against B1 lies below zero
clause_2_combination.additivity: (B5e - anchor) CI95 against +15.16 pp official (+12.73 pp v3); the verdict states inside / above (sub-additive) / below (super-additive)
clause_2_combination.reported_not_gating: (B5e - B4b) under the same three clauses, as M1's contribution inside the combination

clause_3_harmful.HARMFUL: (B5e - B1) pooled SLU CI95 UPPER bound < -1.1218, or (B5e - B1) intent CI95 LOWER bound < -1.0051

delta_convention: delta = right minus left, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p for intent, scenario, action, row exact slot F1 and row SLU-F1, on every contrast
net harmed rows per scenario, flagging any scenario with five or more (owner decision 17), on every contrast

the M1 diagnostics recomputed on cell B5e's own sealed outputs: realized candidate-union coverage against A2's 0.9722 and against cell B1's own value; the Solver escape-to-neighbour-intent rate; exemplar token volume actually rendered per row; revision counts and review-loop dispositions against the anchor's 5, cell B1's 7 and the twin's 9

the B4b per-type slot decomposition (date, time, media_type, transport_type, business_type, order_type, relation, event_name false negatives and false positives, plus the omission / all-exact / partial / exact-mention / spurious-mention table) recomputed on cell B5e's own sealed outputs with the official scorer's own matching, read against cell B4b's first-pass numbers

recovery.why: INFRASTRUCTURE, coordinator-caused. All three SAEA Windows Scheduled Tasks stopped the instant the coordinator changed the power scheme with powercfg, because schtasks-created tasks carry the default stop-on-battery condition; the task-owned resident llama-server died mid-request and the campaign saw 'Remote end closed connection without response' / a broken pipe. Host memory was 45.6 GB free, there was no OOM, and there was no harness or config error. Code, configuration and request bytes are unchanged.
recovery.no_partial_read: The aborted attempt's 25 contacts were never scored and never read; no partial quality read is permitted, and the recovery's own complete manifest is the only thing this recipe reads.
